title: Evening digest: Medicare fugitive link, Adilabad DJ case, DUTA chief to Congress, NDA-UCC rift, BJP wins Kota
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TOP 5 TODAY
source: Munsif Daily / The Hindu / Telangana Today
bullets_en: US Medicare fraud: an Indian-origin fugitive may be hiding in Hyderabad, reports suggest.
DJ system seized and case booked against Ganesh pandal organisers in Adilabad.
Former DUTA chief Aditya Narayan Mishra joins Congress, flags 'crisis' in education.
Rift within the NDA over the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code in Bihar.
BJP wins Kota municipal elections; chairperson poll postponed after EVM glitches.
bullets_ur: US Medicare fraud case mein ek Indian-origin fugitive Hyderabad mein ho sakta hai, reports ke mutabiq.
Adilabad mein Ganesh pandal organisers ke khilaf case darj, DJ system zabt kar liya gaya.
Former DUTA chief Aditya Narayan Mishra Congress mein shamil ho gaye, education par 'crisis' ka zikr kiya.
Bihar mein UCC ke nafaaz par NDA ke andar ikhtilaf paida ho gaya hai.
BJP ne Kota municipal elections mein kamyabi hasil ki; chairperson ka poll EVM glitches ke baad moakhir.
